headline.title: First flakes for Adirondacks.
headline.text: Up to {{s:2}} on the summit of Whiteface early Friday to Saturday morning. 29 of 31 resorts get cold enough nights for snow guns this week, mostly in White Mountains and Western Maine. Killington typically opens first, around Nov 8.

insights.text: First flakes: about {{s:0.5}} at the summit Friday morning to early Saturday (models {{r:0.4,5.2}}). It starts as rain ({{l:0.72}}) before cold air arrives. Rain reaches the summit Friday morning as the snow level climbs to about {{e:10700}}. It won't last: highs reach {{t:49}} Monday.
Snowmaking window early Saturday to Sunday morning: 31 hours with summit wet-bulb temps at or below {{t:27}}, bottoming out near {{t:18}} (the base gets 15 of those hours).
Typically opens around Nov 27, 44 days out. Openings depend on snowmaking nights, not the calendar.
